name: desktop-agent-starter
description: Generic macOS starter for desktop agents: Electron shell, overlay and edge windows, permission onboarding, hardened IPC, a screen-capture ring buffer, input and window sensors, and a no-overwrite rename primitive. No product logic.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --config.directories.output="${RELEASE_DIR:-$HOME/desktop-agent-starter-release}" && node scripts/sign-adhoc.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('postinstall: nothing to rebuild (N-API addons are ABI-stable across Electron versions)')"

author: Austin John
